title: Associativity of section-normalized integral pullback compositors
statement: For any Operations o and Compositors c of [def-sf-integral-system-operations], the recorded pullback comparison c.pullComp obeys associativity on arbitrary triples of composable scheme morphisms: c(f,gh) followed by c(g,h) whiskered by P_f equals the transport for f(gh)=(fg)h followed by c(fg,h) and P_h whiskered c(f,g). This is an equality of natural isomorphisms in the full system derived categories.

source.place: Tags 0F7B--0F7K; agent expansion of the blueprint composition/refinement calculation

proof.text: Evaluate the two ordinary direct-image comparison composites on sections at (n,U). The sections field expresses both as restriction maps along the canonical triple fibre-product maps. The fibre-product pasting identity equates these maps, including the equality transport for associativity.

The recorded conjugate equation identifies ordinaryPull with the inverse left-adjoint comparison. Associativity of adjunction conjugation transfers the ordinary direct-image equation to ordinary inverse image, including its endpoint transport.

The pullComp_model factorization uniquely identifies the derived comparison with localization of ordinaryPull followed by the standard derived-composition comparison. Localization extensionality and its compositor coherence descend the ordinary associativity equation.
